terra.problem: “Nothing buried” asserts a detail the verse does not give. It does not mention hidden treasure.
The verse says the creditors will arise, not that nobody forgets or that they bring receipts.
The verse does not say the creditors have forgotten nothing. It says they will arise.
The boomerang joke follows a verse that also names bloodshed and violence. A card involving violence should not have a joke.
A cookie with no dough is not a clear comparison. The image does not explain unjust gain.
“If it were honest gain, there'd be no woe” goes beyond what the verse says.
The verse says he places his nest on high; it does not say he builds his house high or climbs up.
“to escape the hand of disaster!” is not an exact BSB quote. The verse says “and escape the hand of disaster!”
The talking-bricks line draws its humor from the passage's own image of stones crying out, making the way Scripture is written the joke.
“He's building bigger now” adds a progression in the man's actions that the text does not state.
The text does not say the proud man wanted gold. It says the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD's glory, not simply that His glory will fill it.
“He wanted to look big” assigns him a desire the text does not give.
“What he did” identifies him as the one who destroyed the animals. The verse does not explicitly say who destroyed them.
